I am the beneficiary of two blind trusts administered at arm's length that were not established for political reasons. I am ordered by the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner, as required by subsection 41.3(2) of the Parliament of Canada Act, not to derive any income from them, including the distribution of assets on their termination, for the purpose of financing a nomination contest, a leadership contest or an electoral campaign.
